rules.FLOOR: Floor per product type: CARD 12% of arrears rounded up to the next £5, minimum £25, capped at the arrears (Priya's correction); PLOAN contractual payment; MOTOR contractual payment, full arrears in band 3.
rules.DEADLINE: Deadline per band and product type, counted in business days after today; MOTOR band 2 is the 3rd business day (memo CO-26-14); holidays include 2026-11-27 but not 2026-12-07 (CO-26-15).
rules.BDAY: Business days are Monday to Friday minus the holiday list as amended by both memos.
rules.CALLBACK: Callback today or next business day, after now, Mon-Thu 09:00-20:00, Fri 09:00-16:00 (corrected).
rules.LADDER: Three-step ladder per product; attempts by band; opening ask not counted; last business day of this week (next week's if today is it); clamp to deadline; repeated steps skipped and not counted.
rules.IDENTITY: Date of birth then postcode; DOB as DDMMYYYY; the third wrong answer ends it (corrected).
rules.CODES: Codes per code list and memos: CLAIMED_PAID replaces PAID; N-DISP not the deprecated N-DSP; hardship goes to Q-VULN.
rules.SWITCH: An answer about another product is handled for that product, the open offer is repeated without using an attempt.
rules.TOOMUCH: 'Too much' re-offers the same step with the floor; later steps use the floor; repeats are skipped.
rules.AFTERDL: A date after the deadline gets a counter-offer on the deadline with the named amount.
rules.READBACK: A change at the read-back is re-validated (holiday moved to the next business day) and read back again.
rules.FAIL: A failed create_promise is never retried; the product is noted N-SYS; others stay.
rules.DISPUTE: A dispute on one product is noted N-DISP and the call continues.
rules.PAIDALL: All products already paid: notes N-PAID, outcome CLAIMED_PAID.
rules.RESTR: Restructuring transfers; agreed but unrecorded promises are dropped; no notes.
